project_title: Kalshi EV Combo Devigger & Sportsbook Arbitrage Software

layout_and_spacing.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-6

header_nav.description: Top fixed/sticky header with logo, view tabs (Scanner / Combo Builder), live API status indicator, refresh status, and 'How It Works' modal button.

opticodds_setup_banner.description: Prominent warning banner displayed when OpticOdds SGP pricer API key is unconfigured or inactive.

controls_bar.description: Sticky action panel with controls: game dropdown, devig method toggle, fee toggle, min EV slider/input, +EV filter switch, and book multiselect.

scanner_table.description: High-density matrix table displaying players, Kalshi DD/TD markets, yes/no asks, fair prob %, fair odds, EV% for YES/NO, book counts, and source tags.

combo_builder_page.description: Custom SGP Devig Workbench allowing users to select game, player, select legs (10+ pts, 10+ reb, 10+ ast), enter Kalshi quote in cents, and evaluate devigged EV%.

how_it_works_modal.description: Explainer dialog detailing the mathematical devig formulas (Multiplicative, Additive, Power, Worst-case), Kalshi fee deductions, and OpticOdds SGP synthetic pricing.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a desktop-first, fully responsive dark-theme quantitative sports betting dashboard for Kalshi double-double and triple-double EV devigging.
Target file format is React JavaScript (.js) files in /app/frontend/src/.
Implement the devig algorithms cleanly: Multiplicative (proportional remove vig), Additive (equal spread), Power (exponential/shin approximation), and Worst-case (most conservative book line).
Calculate EV% correctly: EV% = (Fair_Probability * Payout_After_Kalshi_Fee) - (1 - Fair_Probability) * Risk.
Include a Kalshi taker fee toggle (7% standard fee on net gain or cents fee calculation) to show raw vs net EV%.
Ensure every row in the Scanner page is expandable to reveal per-sportsbook SGP odds (DraftKings, BetMGM, Caesars, Fanatics, BetRivers) and leg-by-leg probabilities.
Provide mock/fallback live data generator for NBA games and Kalshi quotes when live OpticOdds API key is not connected, with clear indicator banner.
Apply strict data-testid attributes across all buttons, inputs, table rows, and status indicators as defined in key_components.

design_principles: Dark mode void aesthetic with high contrast data density
Mono fonts (JetBrains Mono) for all odds, probabilities, cents, and EV percentages
Subtle 1px borders with dark blue/slate tint (border-slate-800) instead of flat gray
Color-coded EV percentages: glowing green (#10B981) for positive EV, soft red (#EF4444) for negative EV
Cardless or structured dark panel containers with subtle backdrop blur
Micro-animations for row expansion, toggle switches, and real-time refresh pulses
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive buttons, selects, inputs, and core data cells MUST have data-testid attributes.
